description.en: A desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: a chibi blue-haired maid with 106 hand-drawn transparent animations that wanders across the desktop, reacts to clicks, and chats through a local Ollama instance or the DSH online models.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的桌面宠物：Q 版蓝发小女仆，包含 106 个手绘透明动画，可在桌面漫步、响应点击，并通过本地 Ollama 或 DSH 在线模型聊天。
